svg.desc: One full tick = 500 cases / month; Floating steps show signed change; opening and closing bars start at zero, with dashed cumulative guides. Closing = opening + every signed change. Each step continues from the previous cumulative value. This is a simulated reconciliation, not verified savings; check that one measure is not counted twice.
